scope: static special-encounter data directly compared between Japanese revisions
notes: Pikachu Rev0A stores GoodRodMons at a different offset from RevB-D, but the four semantic bytes are identical.
Pikachu SuperRod comparison is restricted to the exact 31 x 9-byte map records plus terminator; adjacent revision-dependent data is excluded.
Generation III FireRed Rev0/Rev1 has no static standard-wild changes; roamer behavior is code-driven and is tracked as a shared FR/LG system rather than as a static-table revision delta.
